rules.accepted_credit_types: CNE in the nurse's area of practice approved by a Board-recognized credentialing agency or provider (e.g. ANCC, AACN, AANP, ENA, US colleges and universities, LVNAT, TLVN); academic courses, program development/presentation and publications can also count
rules.alternatives: Instead of 20 contact hours: achieving, maintaining or renewing a Board-approved national nursing certification in the area of practice during the licensing period (targeted requirements still apply).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from most requirements at the first (timely) renewal after initial licensure, except forensic evidence collection if it applies.
rules.audit_note: No documents sent unless audited (Rule 216.9). Keep certificates/transcripts for 3 licensing periods or 6 years; forensic evidence course records indefinitely.

topics.who: All nurses: nursing jurisprudence and ethics; CNE only, certification does not count
Nurses providing direct patient care; HHSC-approved course
Nurses whose practice includes older adult or geriatric populations
Nurses working in an ER setting (incl. float, agency, per diem); within 2 years of starting ER employment

rules.notes: License expires the last day of the birth month, in odd or even years matching the birth year.
